name: What are the signs that my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my kitchen faucet needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate your kitchen faucet might need replacement. Persistent dripping or leaks, even after minor repairs, are a common indicator, leading to water waste and potential damage. Visible rust or corrosion on the faucet body or handles suggests wear. If the water pressure has significantly decreased, or if the handles are stiff, loose, or difficult to operate, it might be time for a new one. Additionally, if the finish is severely worn or you simply want to update your kitchen's aesthetic, replacement is a good option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs your faucet needs replacement include persistent leaks, rust, corrosion, low water pressure, stiff handles, or a worn finish.
